#{uid}

select count(1) from SYS_User u left join SYS_Position_User pu on u.U_ID=pu.U_ID left join SYS_Position p on pu.P_ID=p.P_ID left join SYS_Department d on d.D_ID=p.D_ID left join SYS_Company c on c.C_ID=u.C_ID left join SYS_PositionLV plv on plv.PL_ID=u.PL_ID
p.P_Id is not null

and u.U_Name like concat('%',#{uName},'%')
